input: Security hardening: the session cookie named sid is set without SameSite and without the Secure flag on app.example.com. We want SameSite=Lax and Secure. Do not use Strict, it breaks the OAuth redirect from partner.example.net. Set in middleware/session.js line 57.
wrong:
Title: Harden cookies
- set SameSite=Strict on the sid cookie
- middleware/session.js line 57

Title: Cookie flags
- sid cookie needs the Secure flag
- change it in session.js
correct_alts:
Session cookie lacks SameSite and Secure
- The sid cookie is issued with neither attribute.
- Set SameSite=Lax and Secure in middleware/session.js, line 57.
- Lax is required because Strict would break the OAuth redirect from the partner site.

Harden the sid cookie
Currently the sid cookie goes out without SameSite or Secure. Add SameSite=Lax and the Secure flag where it is set, on line 57 of middleware/session.js. Do not choose Strict, which breaks the partner OAuth flow.
